overview_description.description:
Fujairah Oil Terminals (FOT) is a world class 1.177 million cubic meter onshore oil storage facility based in the rapidly developing port of Fujairah, which is located in the United Arab Emirates outside the Straits of Hormuz on the Indian Ocean.

FOT is an independent third party storage and owned by a group of shareholders including the government of Fujairah.

FOT stores crude oil, fuel oil, gasoil and gasoline.

product.name: Onshore Oil Storage
product.description: A facility with a capacity of 1.177 million cubic meters for storing crude oil, fuel oil, gas oil, and gasoline.

product.name: Loading and Discharging
product.description: Services for loading and discharging barges, vessels, and very large crude carriers (VLCCs) for crude oil and refined products.

product.name: Blending and Circulation
product.description: Services for blending and circulating stored oil products to meet specific requirements.

product.name: Heating
product.description: Heating services for stored oil products to maintain or achieve desired temperatures.

product.name: Additive Injection
product.description: Injection of additives into stored oil products to enhance their properties.

product.name: Inter-tank Transfers
product.description: Transfers of oil products between different storage tanks within the facility.
